name: clause_add
description: Save a reusable contract or proposal clause to the library. Use {{variables}} in the body for the facts that change per client, for example {{client}}, {{fee}} or {{late_fee_percent}}. Free tier: 10 own clauses on top of the 25 starters.

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: Clause heading, for example 'Late Payment'

arguments.name: body
arguments.desc: The clause text. {{variable}} placeholders are filled at assembly time

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Grouping, for example parties, scope, payment, expenses, ip, confidentiality

arguments.name: variables
arguments.desc: Declared variable names. Anything {{...}} in the body is detected anyway

arguments.name: jurisdiction
arguments.desc: Where the clause is meant to apply, for example 'PL' or 'England and Wales'

arguments.name: language
arguments.desc: ISO language code, default en

name: clause_get
description: Return a clause in full by id or by title, with its variables and, in Pro, its revision count.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Clause id, for example late-fees

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: Clause title; a partial title matches too

name: clause_update
description: Change the text, category, tags, variables or jurisdiction of a clause. In Pro the previous text is kept as a version; in the free tier the change is applied without history.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Clause id or exact title

name: clause_delete
description: Remove a clause from the library. A deleted starter clause is not re-seeded on the next call.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Clause id or exact title

name: clause_list
description: List every clause, newest categories first, optionally narrowed to one category.

name: clause_search
description: Ranked search over clause titles, tags, categories and bodies. Title and tag matches outrank body matches. Filtering by jurisdiction or tags is a Pro feature.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Words to look for, for example 'late payment interest'

arguments.name: tags
arguments.desc: Pro: every tag listed must be present

arguments.name: jurisdiction
arguments.desc: Pro: exact jurisdiction match

name: clause_import
description: Bulk-load clauses from a file. Markdown form: '## Title', optional 'category:' / 'tags:' / 'variables:' lines, blank line, body. JSON form: an array of clauses. JSON import is a Pro feature; markdown import works in the free tier within the free clause cap.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to a .md or .json file

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace clauses whose title already exists instead of skipping them

name: clause_export
description: Write the whole library to a file. Markdown export is free; JSON export is a Pro feature.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Destination file path

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: json (Pro) or markdown (free)

name: contract_assemble
description: Build a contract or proposal from library clauses: orders them, fills {{variables}} from the values you pass, leaves every missing fact as a bracketed prompt like [late fee percent], prepends the not-legal-advice line, and writes a .docx or a markdown file. Free tier: up to 8 clauses per document.

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: Document title, for example 'Service Agreement - Beta Corp'

arguments.name: clause_ids
arguments.desc: Clause ids in the order they should appear

arguments.name: categories
arguments.desc: Instead of ids: every clause in these categories, ordered by category

arguments.name: values
arguments.desc: Variable values, for example {"fee":"4500","late_fee_percent":"2"}

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Client name; also fills the {{client}} variable

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. Default: the server data directory

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: docx (default) or markdown

name: variables_list
description: Given a set of clauses, list every {{variable}} they use and which clause uses it, so nothing is missed before assembling.

arguments.name: clause_ids
arguments.desc: Clause ids or titles

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
